title: Home page loads primary firm overview content

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the firm overview content is displayed
Verify service highlights are displayed

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link to view practice areas
Verify the practice areas content is displayed

steps.description: Navigate to /

steps.description: Navigate to /
Click the navigation link to contact the firm
Verify the contact form is displayed

title: Home page displays fallback when primary content is missing
description: Verifies the home page shows an error or fallback message if the main content is unavailable.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Wait for the page to finish loading
Verify either the primary firm overview content is displayed or an error/fallback message is visible

title: Practice Areas page loads list of areas and descriptions
description: Verifies the Practice Areas page renders practice areas content for prospective clients.

steps.description: Navigate to /areas
Verify a list of practice areas is displayed
Verify practice area descriptions are displayed

title: Practice Areas page navigation to Contact works
description: Verifies a visitor can proceed from Practice Areas to the contact page using navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /areas
Click the navigation link to contact the firm
Verify the contact form is displayed

title: Practice Areas page navigation to Blog works
description: Verifies a visitor can proceed from Practice Areas to browse related blog content using navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /areas
Click the navigation link to view the blog
Verify a list of articles is displayed

title: Practice Areas shows message when content is unavailable
description: Verifies the Practice Areas page indicates content is unavailable when the practice area content is missing.

steps.description: Navigate to /areas
Wait for the page to finish loading
Verify either the practice areas content is displayed or a content-unavailable message is visible

title: Blog listing loads and displays article summaries
description: Verifies the blog listing page renders a list of articles with summary information.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog
Verify a list of articles is displayed
Verify article summary information is displayed

title: Open an article from the blog list and read full content
description: Verifies a visitor can open an article from the blog list and see the full article content.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog
Click an article in the list
Verify full article content is displayed

title: Return from an opened article to continue browsing
description: Verifies a visitor can navigate from an opened article back to the blog listing using in-app navigation.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog
Click an article in the list
Click the navigation control to return to the blog list
Verify a list of articles is displayed

title: Blog listing shows error or retry UI when articles fail to load
description: Verifies the blog listing presents an error state or retry affordance if the article list cannot be loaded.

steps.description: Navigate to /blog
Wait for the page to finish loading
Verify either a list of articles is displayed or an error/retry message is visible

title: Submit contact form successfully
description: Verifies a visitor can submit the contact form and sees a submission acknowledgement.

steps.description: Navigate to /contato
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Fill a valid phone number into the phone field
Fill a short inquiry into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a submission confirmation and acknowledgement is visible

title: Contact form required-field validation
description: Verifies submitting the contact form with missing required fields shows validation errors and does not submit.

steps.description: Navigate to /contato
Submit the contact form
Verify validation errors are visible
Verify the contact form is still displayed

title: Contact form invalid email validation
description: Verifies the contact form prevents submission when the email format is invalid.

steps.description: Navigate to /contato
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill invalid-email into the email field
Fill a short inquiry into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify an email validation error is visible

title: Contact form message length validation (empty message)
description: Verifies the contact form prevents submission when the message is empty.

steps.description: Navigate to /contato
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Submit the contact form
Verify a message validation error is visible

title: Contact page loads primary content
description: Verifies the contact page loads and displays its main contact information and form.

steps.description: Navigate to /contato
Verify the contact form is displayed
Verify contact information is displayed

title: Contact form clears or remains in a post-submit state after successful submission
description: Verifies the UI transitions to a clear post-submit state after submitting the contact form.

steps.description: Navigate to /contato
Fill a valid name into the name field
Fill a valid email into the email field
Fill a short inquiry into the message field
Submit the contact form
Verify a submission confirmation is visible
Verify the contact form is no longer editable or is reset for a new submission
